title: US-060 Flag an installation that needs scaffolding
description: Mariia adds a Scaffolding Required checkbox on the installation, visible to the crews and set by the planners. It works, and the operations lead holds it until the crews have been briefed: this is the second story Lab 3.10 leaves behind in uat.
commitMessage:
US-060 Flag an installation that needs scaffolding

Installation__c.Scaffolding_Required__c, on the layout, readable by
Helios_Delivery_Crew and editable by Helios_Delivery_Manager.
prTitle: US-060 Flag an installation that needs scaffolding
prBody:
Crews find out on site that a roof cannot be reached without scaffolding, and lose the day.
This lets the planner say so before anybody drives.

- New checkbox `Installation__c.Scaffolding_Required__c`
- On the Installation layout, after Roof Type
- `Helios_Delivery_Crew`: read
- `Helios_Delivery_Manager`: read and edit

Story: US-060 in BACKLOG.md
nextStep: Review it and merge it into integration, then take the next story: Lab 3.10 step 2 gives the order.
